title: Agnar is retiring soon
excerpt: After 44 years of dedicated work, Agnar Bøtun is ready for retirement - or is he?

children.text: After 44 years of dedicated work, Agnar Bøtun is ready for retirement - or is he?
Agnar is our longest-serving employee to date, with an impressive 44 years behind him.
– I feel very privileged to have had such a good workplace for so long, Agnar says with a smile.
Part of the entire journey
When Agnar joined Fresvik Produkt in December 1980, he became the sixth employee. He quickly became an important part of the growing team.
Agnar has witnessed many milestones, changes, highs and lows at Fresvik Produkt since 1980. He says it has been very exciting to see Fresvik Produkt develop and grow.

– In the beginning, we shipped a great deal by boat. Everything going north or south went by boat. At that time, three freight routes operated each week. We had to transport everything we were sending by lorry down to the quay. The quay was a hive of activity! Eventually, everything switched to road transport. It is quite a difference, Agnar recalls with a smile.
He goes on to describe his experience of Fresvik Produkt as a workplace.

– It is a very flexible workplace. It has never been a problem to take time off when you need to do something. It is not only about pay. Industry in general is not at the top end when it comes to wages, but here we have flexibility. Good working conditions count for more than pay.
“I feel very privileged to have had such a good workplace for so long.”
- Agnar
Warehousing, packing and dispatch
Agnar has had many different duties during his time here. In the mid-1980s, he became a foreman, a position he held for nearly 25 years.

– Otherwise, I have worked extensively with transport, packing and dispatch. In recent years, I have worked a great deal in the warehouse while also working closely with the procurement manager. I have also received incoming goods.
Agnar has also assisted with reviewing our employees' payroll for many years. In other words, he has held many different roles here at Fresvik Produkt.
Not quite ready yet
He is not quite ready for retirement yet. We have persuaded him to stay with us a little longer! Agnar will work 50% until the summer. After that, Agnar will be fully retired.
– I am glad about that; otherwise, I would only have had a few working days left before Christmas. That would have been emotional!
Agnar will not be short of things to do in retirement.

– There are always things to be done. We have a cabin at Os where I plan to replace the roof and do various other jobs. We have a motorhome, and we no longer need to be back home by Sunday evening! I also feel that I have neglected the sea. I have a boat, so it will be enjoyable to spend more time at sea fishing!
We are very pleased to have Agnar with us for a little longer and wish him well as he enters partial retirement.

title: An investment to keep up with the times
excerpt: After the summer holidays this year, we were excited to put the robot and what we call the “chaos warehouse”, where the panels are stored, into operation.

children.text: In the summer of 2022, we began work on automating packing in production.
After the summer holidays this year, we were excited to put the robot and what we call the “chaos warehouse”, where the panels are stored, into operation.
The investment was made to create better and safer workplaces for our employees. It also helps us make a better product for our customers and streamline our work.

Once the panels have been produced, the robot moves them into the warehouse. Each panel has a unique barcode that the robot registers. When something is to be dispatched, the robot first retrieves a pallet and then selects the correct panels. The robot then places the panels on the pallet. Once all the panels are in place, they are currently covered manually with plastic and prepared for dispatch. This saves the packing staff from heavy lifting. The entire process also becomes more efficient.
Automation makes the working day easier.

We are continually working to improve the robot and the surrounding processes so that it can be as efficient as possible. It is an advanced machine, and we are still testing how best to adapt the robot to our production.
It will be exciting to see how automation develops from here!

title: A positive story from Fresvik Produkt
excerpt: Fresvik Produkt does a great deal to help our customers with various challenges, and we are very happy to do so!

children.text: Fresvik Produkt does a great deal to help our customers with various challenges, and we are very happy to do so!
Occasionally, we are presented with challenges that fall well outside our usual field:
One day, we received a call from a man who was trapped inside a cold room at a large shopping centre.
He was apparently there to carry out a job, and when he had finished, the door had been blocked from the outside (presumably by accident).
The person had a mobile phone with him, but he was new to the job and had few relevant telephone numbers to call.
Fresvik Produkt came to the rescue!

Fortunately, the door to the room had been supplied by Fresvik Produkt, and the telephone number for the factory in Fresvik was displayed on it. He called us and reached our helpful receptionist, who immediately set things in motion.
Although Fresvik Produkt is located on the other side of the country, we resolved the situation. We contacted people at the shopping centre who located the cold room and the person trapped inside.
Everything ended well - and Fresvik Produkt performed the good deed of the day!!
Yet another good reason to buy products from Fresvik Produkt!!?

children.text: Did you know that Fresvik Produkt has a highly effective solution for fastening panels to the floor?
We find that this solution is not as well known among our customers as it should be.
A channel is cast into the panel for the fastening, and the solution can be used both against the floor and on a plinth.
This is a concealed fastening using square-section tubing, which has been very well received where
The solution leaves no edges where dirt can accumulate, making it particularly suitable for the food industry, where hygiene requirements are stringent.
The floor/plinth must be 100% level where this solution is used when installing panels.

title: John Bøthun is retiring
excerpt: Fresvik Produkt's current longest-serving employee will retire on 1 September.

children.text: Fresvik Produkt's current longest-serving employee will retire on 1 September. In this farewell interview, we look back at earlier times and discuss what makes someone remain at the same workplace for so long.

Fresvik Produkt began production in 1980, and activity was already starting to increase in 1982. John was attending a military refresher exercise with one of FP's employees. During a telephone call with the company, it emerged that more staff were needed, and John was asked over the phone whether he would like to join. He said yes, and that marked the start of an employment relationship that has now lasted since March 1982. No job interview was required!
Ten years in production and assignments throughout the country

John was naturally employed in production, as the administration at that time consisted solely of the general manager. Much has changed over the years, not least all the requirements imposed on a company, whether large or small!

At the outset, only a small team worked at the company, and loyalty was a defining characteristic of them all. They were all committed to making the company succeed. There were few employee welfare arrangements such as those we have today. But the employees worked hard and perhaps thought more about the company than their own benefit.

For his first 10 years, John worked in production. During this period, he also travelled on many installation assignments with other colleagues. These took place throughout the country, but he particularly remembers an assignment in Tromsø where they stayed for 6 consecutive weeks. Travelling home for the weekend was out of the question! The days were long, but the assignment was enjoyable.
Production at that time involved little automation, and almost all the work was manual. New tasks were addressed as they arose, and the team found solutions to most challenges together.
Technical drawing as a new primary responsibility

John spent 10 enjoyable years in production, performing a variety of duties and also serving as acting foreman for a period. Then he was called into the office. At the end of 1992, the company purchased its first drawing software; until then, everything had been drawn by hand. Turnover increased, creating a need for more staff as well as automation. Technical drawing now became John's responsibility, but the company needed more expertise, so John went to Sogndal and attended the technical college there, completing one year of technical drawing studies.

When John returned to the company, technical drawing became his main responsibility. Since 2006, John has worked in a combined role as a draughtsman and production planner. Short deadlines have characterised his working day. Nevertheless, John highlights the varied work, influence over his duties and contact with many pleasant people, both colleagues and customers, as enjoyable aspects of the job.

For many years, John also served as the employees' representative on the board of Fresvik Produkt. This involved many interesting matters and contributions. Because John had extensive knowledge of the entire company and its production, he also participated in decisions on major investments in the company. Among other things, he travelled to Italy when we were purchasing our second production line.
A love of the workplace and the village

Fresvik Produkt has undergone major changes over these 45 years. The company has grown from a start-up with few employees into a medium-sized company with around 40 employees and a sales office in Drammen. Nevertheless, we have managed to preserve the positive working environment. Without great job satisfaction and a love of both his workplace and village, John would not have remained at work for so long. John points out that he has settled in Fresvik and enjoys living in the village where he grew up. Although such a small place can have both advantages and disadvantages, the advantages must outweigh the disadvantages when one chooses to settle here.
Fresvik Produkt would like to thank John for the tremendous contribution he has made to the company and wishes him many happy years in retirement!

children.text: For many years, Fresvik Produkt has maintained significant production of sliding gates, a product area that showed healthy growth in 2014.
At the factory in Fresvik, we manufacture custom-built sliding gates to order, producing and assembling the gates with fittings, frames and seals.

The sliding gates are manufactured according to the customer's dimensions and specifications. Many customers need a personnel door integrated into the sliding gate, among other things, and we are also seeing increased demand for automatic gates, i.e. electrically operated gates that are often selected when the gate needs to be opened from, for example, a forklift.

The door leaf consists of a galvanised steel sheet with a polyester-coated surface (Foodsafe). The gate leaf can also be supplied in stainless or acid-resistant steel. If it is a sliding gate for a freezer room (freezer gate), it is supplied with a threshold and an integrated self-regulating 220 V heating cable.
The vast majority of this production is supplied to the food industry, but we also manufacture a number of custom-built sliding gates for warehouses, boats and offshore use.
Here is a new sliding gate on its way to Isowest AS at Eidsnes near Ålesund.
If you would like more information about our sliding gates, industrial hinged doors or our standard doors for cold rooms, freezer rooms or ships, please contact our sales department.

title: We have become Eco-Lighthouse certified
excerpt: We are proud and pleased to have finally achieved Eco-Lighthouse certification.

children.text: This autumn, Fresvik Produkt became Eco-Lighthouse certified.
This demonstrates our focus on sustainability and green values in our work.

Fresvik Produkt has always focused on avoiding pollution of both the external environment and the indoor working environment. Located amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Western Norway, we understand the importance of rewarding experiences in nature for both people and our surroundings.
However, through our work to achieve Eco-Lighthouse certification, we have placed even greater emphasis on this and considered our work from a broader perspective.

We are and will remain a safe workplace in the local community, focusing on creating jobs where everyone thrives and sickness absence is low. We will seek to reduce our energy consumption and use the energy we need as efficiently as possible. We also focus on reducing the use of cardboard and plastic and reusing these materials wherever possible.
To help create a sustainable society, we will also ask our suppliers for the most environmentally friendly products available.
Together with many others, Fresvik Produkt can help create a better, more sustainable environment in the years ahead.

migrationCards.title: What is the main difference between PIR and PUR in cold and freezer rooms?
migrationCards.text: The main difference lies in their fire properties. PIR generally has better fire resistance and lower smoke development than PUR, while both materials have very good thermal insulation properties.

migrationCards.title: In which projects should PIR be preferred over PUR?
migrationCards.text: PIR should be preferred in projects where fire safety and risk reduction are particularly important. This applies especially to: Large cold and frozen storage facilities. Buildings with strict fire safety requirements. Industrial and commercial buildings. Projects where insurance companies impose additional requirements. Facilities storing high-value goods. In such cases, PIR provides a better safety margin while maintaining a high level of thermal insulation performance. If you are unsure which material is best suited, PIR is a safe choice. It provides additional fire safety and good thermal insulation performance – a sound choice for most projects.

migrationCards.title: Why do PIR panels have almost the same U-value as PUR panels, but better fire properties?
migrationCards.text: Although PIR and PUR panels have almost the same U-value (thermal insulation performance), PIR has better fire properties because the foam reacts by protecting the surface in the event of a fire and has greater thermal stability. PIR provides equally effective insulation, but withstands heat and fire significantly better than PUR. PIR therefore achieves fire class B, while PUR has class C.

migrationCards.title: Do the PIR panels have a locking mechanism in the joints and corners, like the PUR panels?
migrationCards.text: Our PIR and PUR panels have the same design and the same locking mechanism in the joints and corners.

migrationCards.title: What are PVC strip curtains, and when should they be used in cold rooms or freezer rooms?
migrationCards.text: PVC strip curtains are flexible PVC strips installed in door openings to reduce heat loss and draughts when the door is opened. They are often used in high-traffic cold and freezer rooms where doors are opened frequently. PVC strip curtains help to: Reduce energy loss. Maintain a stable temperature. Prevent warm-air leakage. Improve working comfort. In freezer rooms, specially adapted PVC that withstands low temperatures is used. We produce two types of PVC strip curtains: fixed and sliding PVC strip curtains.

migrationCards.title: What is the difference between a cold room door and a freezer room door?
migrationCards.text: For standard cold and freezer room doors, the difference is that the freezer room door has a heating cable in the frame; otherwise, the doors are identical. For industrial doors, the difference lies in the insulation and construction: A cold room door is designed for cold rooms with moderate temperatures and has insulation and sealing adapted to normal refrigeration operation. A freezer room door is designed for deep-freezing at low sub-zero temperatures and has thicker insulation, a double gasket and a heating cable in the frame to prevent the gaskets from freezing in place.

items.title: How does the weight/density of PIR panels compare with PUR panels?
items.text: PUR panels have a density of 40 ±2 kg/m³ (weight approx. 13 - 17 kg/m2), while PIR panels have a density of 42 ±2 kg/m³ (weight approx. 14 – 18.5 kg/m2).

items.title: Can PIR panels be used at the same temperatures as PUR panels?
items.text: PIR has a temperature range from -40 °C to +70 °C, while PUR withstands temperatures from -40 °C to +120 °C.

items.title: Can the PIR panels be produced in the same sizes as the PUR panels?
items.text: Yes. We offer flexible room heights in increments of 50 mm, up to 8000 mm, and a range of thicknesses: 75 mm, 100 mm, 125 mm, 150 mm and 175 mm.

items.title: Can you produce doors and gates with PIR foam?
items.text: Yes, we supply both doors and gates with PIR foam, with the same design as our PUR products.

items.title: What are cold room panels, and what thickness should be selected for cold rooms and freezer rooms?
items.text: Cold room panels are insulated sandwich panels used for walls, ceilings and, where applicable, floors in cold and freezer rooms. The choice of thickness depends on the room temperature and energy requirements: Cold rooms (2°C – 6°C): Usually 75–100 mm. Freezer rooms (0°C – -40°C): Usually 100–175 mm, depending on U-value and energy-efficiency requirements. Correct dimensioning is important to ensure a stable temperature and low energy consumption.

items.title: Can Fresvik Produkt supply cold and freezer rooms in custom dimensions or for bespoke projects?
items.text: Yes, Fresvik Produkt supplies cold and freezer rooms adapted to the needs of each project. We manufacture panels and solutions in custom dimensions so that the room can be adapted to existing buildings, production facilities or specific customer requirements. We tailor solutions to the customer's needs, whether these involve special dimensions, technical requirements, or larger and more complex facilities.

Fresvik Produkt AS is identified as the owner of the website, with company address, email address and organisation number, and the policy describes how personal data is processed in customer relationships.

The policy also covers disclosure to third parties, customer records, cookies, newsletter signup, contact forms, social sharing, access, correction, deletion and responsibility for processing personal data.

items.text: In connection with customer relationships, we must collect information such as names, addresses, email addresses, telephone numbers, organisation numbers and other necessary information. children.text: Fresvik Produkt delivers cold rooms, freezer rooms, doors, gates and facade panel solutions for food production, retail, institutions, commercial kitchens, laboratories, ships and offshore installations.
The reference overview shows selected projects where Fresvik Produkt has delivered tailored solutions with an emphasis on delivery reliability, quality and practical installation.
The references overview presents selected projects and delivery areas from Fresvik Produkt.

migrationCards.title: Coop Extra Sogndal
migrationCards.text: Fresvik Produkt supplied and installed cold and freezer rooms throughout the Coop Extra Sogndal store, totalling approximately 800 m2 of panels.

migrationCards.title: Interfrukt, our largest project
migrationCards.text: At Langhus in Ski municipality, Anthon B. Nilsen built a new wholesale warehouse for Interfrukt SA. Fresvik Produkt was selected as the supplier of freezer and cold-room walls, delivering a total of 16,500 m2 of cold-room and freezer-room panels.

migrationCards.title: Custom-built freezer room for Baza in Fredrikstad

items.text:
Norway's largest professional environment for insulation panels

A good working environment with friendly colleagues

Good pension and insurance schemes

Offices in Fresvik and Drammen

Would you like to help keep Norway cold? ❄️

Fresvik Produkt AS is seeking a proactive, relationship-oriented SALES REPRESENTATIVE

Are you skilled at building relationships? Do you have technical insight and a passion for good solutions? Then you may be exactly who we are looking for!

Since 1980, Fresvik Produkt has been at the forefront of insulation elements, doors and gates for cold and freezer rooms. As the only Norwegian manufacturer in the market, we are proud to be the market leader in everything from commercial kitchens and shops to ships and offshore installations. We do not merely supply products – we provide customisation and quality that stand up to everyday use.

We are a solid cornerstone company with our head office in beautiful Fresvik in Sogn and a sales office in Drammen. With us, you receive:

Security: A stable workplace in a company with sound finances (turnover of more than NOK 70 million).

Culture: An informal, inclusive and positive working environment.

Terms: Good insurance and pension schemes.

As a sales representative with us, you will not simply sit behind a desk. You will be our public face and will:

Proactively approach both new and existing customers.

Present our solutions at trade fairs and explore new markets.

Act as an adviser during quotation and project phases – we sell solutions, not merely products.

Work closely with our internal departments to develop the products of the future in consultation with our customers.

We believe you will recognise yourself in the following:

You enjoy customer contact and are a natural relationship builder.

You have technical understanding and are enthusiastic about finding the ideal solution for the customer.

You are organised, have good financial understanding and enjoy keeping processes in order.

You have a positive attitude, are willing to learn and are fluent in Norwegian.

Drammen or Fresvik - You choose where you would like to be based!

We are looking to appoint someone soon, so do not wait to send us your application.

Apply for the position: Send your application to ts@personalhuset.no; mark it “Sales Representative Position”

Thomas Skogheim, tel.: 95 76 12 19

An active agricultural village, sheltered and facing the fjord. A safe and positive place to grow up, clubs and organisations for everyone, a music festival, industry and abundant outdoor activities. Welcome to Fresvik.

items.title: Industrial hinged door

Larger hinged door for cold or freezer rooms, intended for industrial use. For example, abattoirs, dairies and wholesale warehouses.

Construction: Door leaf with a surface of 25 µm polyester-coated galvanised steel sheet, type FOODSAFE.

Insulation: Freezer: 100 or 125 mm foamed polyurethane, approx. 40 kg/m3. Cold room: 100 mm foamed polyurethane, approx. 40 kg/m3.

Fittings: Rising hinges. Internal and external opener with slam latch.

Frame: Surface-mounted, made of seawater-resistant anodised aluminium. Freezer doors are supplied with a threshold and an integrated, self-regulating 230 V heating cable. Heating cable output 51 W/metre. The heating cable can be replaced without removing the door.

Sealing: Double EPDM-quality rubber gasket. Double sweep gasket against the floor.

Dimensions: Manufactured to customer-specified dimensions.

Optional extras: Lock with internal emergency release. Stainless-steel door leaf.

items.text:
Standard cold and freezer room door. Intended for small and medium-sized rooms. Also used for inspection hatches and emergency exit hatches in larger installations.

Construction: The door leaf has a surface of galvanised steel sheet with polyester coating, type Foodsafe. Insulated with 80 mm high-pressure foamed polyurethane.

Surface-mounted frame in 2 mm powder-coated galvanised steel. Freezer room doors are supplied with a self-regulating heating cable in the frame. 230 V, 16 W/m. The frame is supplied as standard with a threshold profile. Sealing is provided by a magnetic gasket mounted in a PVC profile on the door leaf. Easy to replace.

Standard delivery: Door leaf with gaskets, mounted in the frame described above. Heating cable in freezer room doors. Preloaded rising hinges.

Optional extras: Threshold-free solution with a sweep strip at the bottom of the door leaf. Recessed threshold for casting into the floor for freezer doors with a sweep strip. Lock with internal emergency release. Stainless-steel door leaf and frame. Door closer, optionally with a hydraulic door closer. Non-standard dimensions. Aluminium access ramp for freezer room doors.

Short delivery time: We stock standard doors. Doors with clear opening widths of 700, 800, 900 and 1000 mm can usually be dispatched the same day or within 48 hours at the latest. Contact us for delivery time and price.

items.text:
Reduces cold loss during periods when the gate remains open for extended periods due to frequent traffic. A PVC strip curtain is a simple and affordable solution that can also be used to divide smaller rooms and enclose machinery and equipment.

Construction: Consists of overlapping transparent PVC strips mounted on an aluminium suspension system.

Supplied in two versions: strip dimensions 300 x 3 mm and strip dimensions 200 x 2 mm. Both are supplied in a cold-resistant version.

Dimensions: PVC strip curtains are supplied in dimensions adapted to most requirements. The 300 x 3 mm size is used in openings with forklift traffic. The 200 x 2 mm size is used in openings with lighter traffic.

Optional extras: Can be supplied on a track so that the curtain can be slid to one side.

items.title: Fresvik Freezing Tunnel
items.text:
Customised for your unique production environment.

In food production, freezing is about more than temperature alone. When raw materials and finished products are frozen quickly and under controlled conditions, their quality is better preserved throughout the entire value chain.

An efficient freezing tunnel helps limit crystal formation, preserve structure and reduce the loss of flavour, texture and shelf life. For producers handling large volumes, this provides more predictable product handling, from production and intermediate storage to onward transport.

With Fresvik Produkt, you receive a solution developed for production environments where capacity, food safety and stable flow are essential. The result is a more controlled freezing process, adapted to the requirements of modern food production.

items.title: Rapid, even and controlled freezing
items.text:
Freezing tunnels from Fresvik Produkt are designed for rapid, even and controlled freezing in demanding production environments.

A reliable solution for food processing companies that need to preserve quality and shelf life while maintaining an efficient production flow.

items.title: Customised PIR Panels and robust details
items.text:
Fresvik Produkt's freezing tunnels are constructed using custom-made PIR panels and robust components, adapted for both maritime and land-based applications.

The solutions are designed to ensure stable freezing temperatures, reduced energy loss, a long service life and an optimal hygienic design. The products are well suited for use on ships, offshore installations and industrial food processing facilities on land.

The freezing tunnels are built using prefabricated PIR insulation panels and custom-made doors, and can be supplied in various dimensions and configurations based on capacity and application. The solutions are also adapted to applicable hygiene, fire classification and operational requirements.

items.title: Customised PIR Panels
items.text: The freezing tunnel is constructed from prefabricated PIR panels manufactured in Fresvik in Sogn. Fire classification B-s1,d0 and a hygienic FoodSafe surface are standard, with thicknesses from 75 to 175 mm adapted to the required capacity and operating temperature. Other surfaces, such as stainless steel or acid-resistant steel, are available on request. Eccentric locks at the joints ensure tight connections and rapid, precise installation on site.
items.imageAlt: Image of a cutaway cross-section of a building wall showing various layers of insulation, vapour and air barriers, and exterior cladding.

items.title: Specially adapted doors
items.text: Each freezing tunnel is supplied with doors manufactured to measure and adapted to the clear opening, operation and application. The standard surface is polyester-coated galvanised sheet steel of FoodSafe quality, with high-pressure polyurethane foam insulation. Other surfaces, such as stainless steel or acid-resistant steel, are available on request. The door is supplied as standard with preloaded rising hinges. For freezer applications, a self-regulating heating cable is also installed in the frame (230 V, 16 W/m).

title: Interfrukt
description:
At Langhus in Ski municipality, Anthon B. Nilsen has constructed a new fruit and vegetable wholesale warehouse covering a total of 21,300 square metres for Interfrukt SA.
Interfrukt sublets space to nine different fruit companies, and the new wholesale warehouse contains dry storage, cold storage, freezer storage and office space.
Fresvik Produkt was selected to supply the freezer and cold room walls for the project, for which Norske Stålbygg was the main contractor. The building is substantial in scale, and our delivery consisted of a total of 16,500 m² of cold and freezer room panels.
- The greatest challenge was the height of 10.5 metres. We manufacture panels up to 8 metres long, so the panels had to be joined, but the tongue-and-groove joints at the ends of the panels provide excellent strength.
Installation took place from August to December 2013 and proceeded without any problems, according to our project manager Arek Lekki.
For more information about our products, please contact our Sales department.

description:
Fresvik Produkt has delivered the very first PIR project produced in Norway.

We are the first Norwegian manufacturer of customised Fresvik PIR Panel with a simple eccentric lock. Fresvik PIR Panel is a sandwich element with expanded PIR foam (polyisocyanurate foam) as its core, enclosed between two steel sheets. The product is approved by SINTEF and developed in Norway.
We would like to thank Kelvin and Kvanne for the good cooperation!
Interested in learning more about our PIR products? Contact our sales department.
